+import json

+from datetime import datetime, timedelta, timezone
+
+import requests
+

+GRAFANA_CLOUD_API_BASE = "https://api.grafana.com"
+
+
+def _parse_timestamp(value: str) -> datetime:
+    if value.endswith("Z"):
+        value = value[:-1] + "+00:00"
+    return datetime.fromisoformat(value)
+
+
+def _normalize_time(value: str | None) -> str:
+    if value:
+        return _parse_timestamp(value).astimezone(timezone.utc).isoformat().replace("+00:00", "Z")
+    return (datetime.now(timezone.utc) - timedelta(minutes=15)).isoformat().replace("+00:00", "Z")
+
+
+def query_metric_dimensions(org_id: str, query: str, start: str | None, end: str | None, step: str, filters: list[str]) -> dict:
+    token = os.environ["GRAFANA_CLOUD_API_TOKEN"]
+    url = f"{GRAFANA_CLOUD_API_BASE}/api/prometheus/{org_id}/api/v1/query_range"
+    params = {"query": query, "start": _normalize_time(start), "end": _normalize_time(end), "step": step}
+    if filters:
+        params["query"] = f'{query}{{{",".join(filters)}}}' if "{" not in query else query
+    response = requests.get(url, params=params, headers={"Authorization": f"Bearer {token}"}, timeout=30)
+    response.raise_for_status()
+    return response.json()
+
+

+    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description="Query Grafana Cloud metric data filtered by labels or dimensions.")

+    parser.add_argument("--query", required=True)
+    parser.add_argument("--start")

+import argparse
+import os
+from datetime import datetime, timezone
+from typing import Any, Dict, Optional
+
+import requests
+
+
+DD_API_HOST = "https://api.datadoghq.com"
+
+
+def _parse_time(value: str) -> int:
+    try:
+        dt = datetime.fromisoformat(value.replace("Z", "+00:00"))
+        if dt.tzinfo is None:
+            dt = dt.replace(tzinfo=timezone.utc)
+        return int(dt.timestamp())
+    except ValueError as exc:
+        raise SystemExit(f"Invalid time value: {value}") from exc
+
+
+def aggregate_metric_stats(metric: str, start: int, end: int, interval: int = 300) -> Dict[str, Any]:
+    api_key = os.environ.get("DATADOG_API_KEY")
+    app_key = os.environ.get("DATADOG_APP_KEY")
+    if not api_key or not app_key:
+        raise SystemExit("DATADOG_API_KEY and DATADOG_APP_KEY must be set")
+
+    url = f"{DD_API_HOST}/api/v1/query"
+    params = {"from": start, "to": end, "query": metric}
+    headers = {
+        "DD-API-KEY": api_key,
+        "DD-APPLICATION-KEY": app_key,
+        "Accept": "application/json",
+    }
+    response = requests.get(url, params=params, headers=headers, timeout=30)
+    response.raise_for_status()
+    payload = response.json()
+
+    series = payload.get("series", []) or []
+    values = []
+    for item in series:
+        for point in item.get("pointlist", []) or []:
+            if len(point) >= 2 and point[1] is not None:
+                values.append(float(point[1]))
+
+    if not values:
+        return {
+            "metric": metric,
+            "start": start,
+            "end": end,
+            "interval": interval,
+            "count": 0,
+            "min": None,
+            "max": None,
+            "avg": None,
+            "sum": 0.0,
+        }
+
+    total = sum(values)
+    return {
+        "metric": metric,
+        "start": start,
+        "end": end,
+        "interval": interval,
+        "count": len(values),
+        "min": min(values),
+        "max": max(values),
+        "avg": total / len(values),
+        "sum": total,
+    }
+
+
+def main() -> None:
+    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description="Retrieve aggregated Datadog metric statistics over a time window")
+    parser.add_argument("metric")
+    parser.add_argument("--start", required=True, help="ISO-8601 datetime or unix timestamp")
+    parser.add_argument("--end", required=True, help="ISO-8601 datetime or unix timestamp")
+    parser.add_argument("--interval", type=int, default=300)
+    args = parser.parse_args()
+
+    start = int(args.start) if args.start.isdigit() else _parse_time(args.start)
+    end = int(args.end) if args.end.isdigit() else _parse_time(args.end)
+    stats = aggregate_metric_stats(args.metric, start, end, args.interval)
+    print(stats)
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    main()
*** End Patch

*** Add File: query_metric_window.py
+import argparse
+import json
+import os
+from datetime import datetime, timedelta, timezone
+
+from datadog_api_client import ApiClient, Configuration
+from datadog_api_client.v1.api.metrics_api import MetricsApi
+
+
+def parse_args():
+    p = argparse.ArgumentParser()
+    p.add_argument("metric_name")
+    p.add_argument("--hours", type=int, default=1)
+    p.add_argument("--from-ts", type=int, dest="from_ts")
+    p.add_argument("--to-ts", type=int, dest="to_ts")
+    return p.parse_args()
+
+
+def main():
+    args = parse_args()
+    end_ts = args.to_ts or int(datetime.now(timezone.utc).timestamp())
+    start_ts = args.from_ts or int((datetime.now(timezone.utc) - timedelta(hours=args.hours)).timestamp())
+
+    configuration = Configuration()
+    configuration.api_key["apiKeyAuth"] = os.environ["DD_API_KEY"]
+    configuration.app_key["apiKeyAuth"] = os.environ["DD_APP_KEY"]
+    configuration.server_variables["site"] = os.getenv("DD_SITE", "datadoghq.com")
+
+    query = f"{args.metric_name}{{*}}"
+    with ApiClient(configuration) as api_client:
+        api = MetricsApi(api_client)
+        response = api.query_metrics(_from=start_ts, to=end_ts, query=query)
+
+    series = []
+    for point in getattr(response, "series", []) or []:
+        for point_data in getattr(point, "pointlist", []) or []:
+            if point_data and len(point_data) == 2 and point_data[1] is not None:
+                series.append({"timestamp": int(point_data[0]), "value": point_data[1]})
+
+    print(json.dumps({"metric": args.metric_name, "from": start_ts, "to": end_ts, "datapoints": series}, indent=2))
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    main()
*** End Patch

+import argparse
+import json
+import os
+from datetime import datetime, timedelta, timezone
+
+from datadog_api_client import ApiClient, Configuration
+from datadog_api_client.v1.api.metrics_api import MetricsApi
+
+
+def parse_args():
+    p = argparse.ArgumentParser()
+    p.add_argument("metric_name")
+    p.add_argument("--hours", type=int, default=1)
+    p.add_argument("--from-ts", type=int, dest="from_ts")
+    p.add_argument("--to-ts", type=int, dest="to_ts")
+    return p.parse_args()
+
+
+def main():
+    args = parse_args()
+    end_ts = args.to_ts or int(datetime.now(timezone.utc).timestamp())
+    start_ts = args.from_ts or int((datetime.now(timezone.utc) - timedelta(hours=args.hours)).timestamp())
+
+    configuration = Configuration()
+    configuration.api_key["apiKeyAuth"] = os.environ["DD_API_KEY"]
+    configuration.app_key["apiKeyAuth"] = os.environ["DD_APP_KEY"]
+    configuration.server_variables["site"] = os.getenv("DD_SITE", "datadoghq.com")
+
+    query = f"{args.metric_name}{{*}}"
+    with ApiClient(configuration) as api_client:
+        api = MetricsApi(api_client)
+        response = api.query_metrics(_from=start_ts, to=end_ts, query=query)
+
+    series = []
+    for point in getattr(response, "series", []) or []:
+        for point_data in getattr(point, "pointlist", []) or []:
+            if point_data and len(point_data) == 2 and point_data[1] is not None:
+                series.append({"timestamp": int(point_data[0]), "value": point_data[1]})
+
+    print(json.dumps({"metric": args.metric_name, "from": start_ts, "to": end_ts, "datapoints": series}, indent=2))
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    main()
